content: Zero-knowledge/local-first vault pattern: encryption/decryption always happens client-side using a key derived from the master password (server or disk never sees plaintext or the key). Single-user local-first reference implementations (e.g. Tauri+Rust+React) persist encrypted vault data to local disk, not a managed backend, by default. Common scheme: master-password-derived key (via strong KDF like Argon2/PBKDF2) unlocks a per-record or per-vault AES-256-GCM (authenticated encryption) key.
